newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK colonial chief secretary to straddle handover.
newsitem.headline: HK colonial chief secretary to straddle handover.

text.p: Hong Kong's colonial chief civil servant Anson Chan will stay on in her post and serve as chief civil servant after the handover of Hong Kong to China, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
China's official news agency also said Financial Secretary Donald Tsang would stay on in his position as Hong Kong's top economic policy planner.
Shipping magnate Tung Chee-hwa will take over from colonial Governor Chris Patten's when Hong Kong reverts to China at the stroke of midnight on June 30, taking on the mantle of Chief Executive.
